posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
Okay, well look at it this way. If we assume that the Staff makes its wielder look more Egyptian (not unreasonable), how come Regular Ra doesn't look very North African at all?

There really isn't much difference at all in how Blake looks before and after the staff. His skin tone hasn't changed much (if at all). His face is more angular and his hair is black instead of brown, but he still looks like his ancestry's primarily Southern European. He only looks more Egyptian because he's wearing Egyptian style clothing.

Thiago on the other hand, also looks like he has European ancestry (or perhaps Middle Eastern, as Ronway suggests). Tactics Ra looks VERY different, like he has at least some North African ancestry.

So why would the staff so drastically change Thiago's appearance when it didn't change Blake's very much?

I mean I like the idea, sure. But it isn't consistent with the way we've seen the staff work before.
